obligations.cost_and_body: Paid BB, BR and RR hybrid alternatives; 3/2 and printed Goblin/Noble metadata.
obligations.counter_trigger: One per positive placement per exact recipient and placing player, across mixed kinds and overlapping Goblin/Orc/Army; controller and placer both must match. Opponent target, actual damage, hexproof, source departure, Doc Samson replacement, Bifur additional triggers, both seats, opponent Azog amass and counter entry. Raw/index/restore and illegal target rollback.
obligations.death_trigger: Another controlled Goblin/Orc/Army permanent dying uses pre-event characteristics, including noncreature Kindred, token and simultaneous source death. Paid Murder, graveyard replacement, public exile, exact-object permission, land limit and next-turn expiry.
obligations.zero_boundary: A zero actual placement and an explicit zero post-replacement event produce no trigger. No admitted factor-zero counter replacement card was found; this is an observer-boundary proof, not a live prevention-card interaction.
